facts.fact: 归家：Maple 先扑 Lucan 再扑 Micah。
facts.anchor: Maple jumps into Lucan’s arms the moment we step inside his apartment.

facts.fact: 培根把 Maple 安顿在厨房。
facts.anchor: Lucan watches us with a fond smile before turning toward the kitchen.
He carries me toward his bedroom as though I weigh nothing.

facts.fact: Lucan 首次说「做爱」而非欲望。
facts.anchor: “I want to make love to you.”
But none of the men I’ve slept with have ever treated me the way Lucan does.

facts.fact: 逐步征求同意的节奏贯穿。

facts.anchor: “Like this,” I insist, pulling him closer. “Wanna see your face.”

facts.fact: 进入前再次确认；中途喊停立即停。
facts.anchor: “Are you sure?” he asks, his brow furrowing.
Eventually, Lucan shifts as though to roll away.

facts.fact: Lucan 事后确认对方无恙；答「神奇」。
facts.anchor: “Did you enjoy that?” he asks quietly.
